en.hubeali: H 14605 – Ja’far, from Anbasar, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’farasws having said that:
‘If Allahazwj Intends to Terminate the affairs of a people, Heazwj Commands the orbit to be Accelerated, in accordance to what Heazwj Intends’.
en.sarwar: 157. Ja’far, from Anbasar, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s.) having said that:
‘If Allah (azwj) Intends to Terminate the affairs of a people, He (azwj) Commands the orbit to be Accelerated, in accordance to what He (azwj) Intends’.
